up: List the distinct targets that have been studied in assays where the assay organism is Escherichia coli. Return the target ChEMBL ID and the preferred target name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Escherichia coli' AND td.chembl_id IS NOT NULL
